about_the_game:
Step into the imperial palace—a place of splendor, yet also a living hell.

You were born as an unremarkable illegitimate daughter, but upon entering the palace, you unexpectedly captured the favor of a cunning emperor. What seemed like a blessing from above soon revealed itself to be shrouded in mystery.

As jealousy brews and conspiracies arise, you find yourself the target of countless schemes. Initially wishing to simply stay out of harm’s way, you accidentally uncover secrets buried deep within the palace. As you delve further, the truth of the past slowly unravels.

A capricious emperor, a mysterious empress, and concubines with vastly different personalities—each harbors their own motives.

In the treacherous depths of the palace, where hearts are fickle and betrayal lurks behind every smile, can you navigate through the countless crises and survive until the end?

Game Features：

1.High degree of freedom in court life:

Experience ultimate freedom—rise to become Empress of the realm or explore countless romantic possibilities. Every choice you make shapes your destiny in the palace.

2.Multi-line plot and character strategy:

From the unpredictable and cunning Emperor, to the serene court musician; from the devoted yet tragic prince, to the rebellious and untamed royal, and even the fiery foreign prince. There’s even a secret female character waiting for you!

Game Rules：

1.Palace Development

Interact with characters through map exploration, chatting, playing chess, and probing conversations to increase affection and attribute points.

2.Intrigue and Assassination System in the Deep Palace

Build your influence, win over ministers and concubines, train maids and assassins, and secretly eliminate your enemies.

3.Experience the Joy of Raising Children

Design courses, arrange exams, correct the prince’s personality, and enjoy the process of raising royal heirs!

4.Luxurious Outfits and Customization

A large selection of exquisite outfits to choose from, with different costumes boosting different attributes, allowing you to craft your unique palace style!

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes depictions of ancient concubines serving the emperor in bed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows7 32bit equivalent or better
  • Processor: Intel® i3-3220, AMD FX 6300 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Radeon 2400 or higher / NVIDIA 8600M or higher / Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Take on the role of Sophia, a concubine's daughter navigating palace intrigue in this court-themed AVG. Gain imperial favor, uncover conspiracies, manage relationships, forge alliances, train assassins, and raise a prince. Enjoy freedom, multi-route plots, and uncover palace secrets.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Indonesian, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese
